abstract: Namecheap is cheaper and GoDaddy has stronger test numbers in Cybernews tests. Check the term and renewal price for each plan.

name: Jamil Ahmed
description: Founder and CEO of Reinforce Lab. Pharmacist, SEO and AI search consultant, and Semrush Ambassador.

acceptedAnswer.text: Namecheap is cheaper. GoDaddy has stronger test numbers in Cybernews tests. Neither wins every round.

mainEntity.name: Which is cheaper, Namecheap or GoDaddy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Namecheap Stellar is $2.28 a month and renews at $5.88. GoDaddy Economy is $5.99 on a 3-year term and renews at $11.99.
In Cybernews tests, GoDaddy had a 822 ms largest contentful paint and 100% uptime. Namecheap had 1,135 ms and 99.29%. The tests were on different dates.

mainEntity.name: Do both offer a money-back guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both list 30 days. Namecheap excludes customers on its free trial.

mainEntity.name: Does either host have a Black Friday sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: We could not confirm one for either host on the pages we read.
